1. Author `_save_verdict.py` per the SKILL.md procedure (steps 1-9 already specified):
   - Argument parsing (--ticket-id, --officer, --body/--body-path, --timestamp, --overwrite, --cwd, --artifact-path, --request-id, --caller).
   - Path validation (officer regex `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`, ticket id regex `^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$`).
   - Timestamp resolution + filename encoding (`strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%SZ')`).
   - Body byte-read (inline or path).
   - Pre-flight dest-exists check (exit 3 if overwrite=false).
   - Byte-faithful write via `write_with_verify` (sha256 round-trip).
   - On-disk re-hash defense-in-depth.
   - Record-artifact write at `agents/save-verdict/<request-id>.txt`.
   - Exit codes per docstring: 0 ok / 2 sha256 mismatch / 3 dest exists / 4 argument error / 5 internal error.

2. Author `_lib/byte_copy.py` with the shared `write_with_verify` primitive (per SKILL.md preservation discipline: "Shares skills/_lib/byte_copy.py with COPY_ARTIFACT and TRANSCRIBE_BW_TO_DISK"). Decide whether to also promote copy-artifact + transcribe-bw-to-disk in this same arc OR to bound scope to save-verdict alone with `_lib/byte_copy.py` shipped as a save-verdict private helper (deferring the cross-skill share).

3. Promote the directory tree to `substrate/skills/save-verdict/`:
   - SKILL.md (re-use the user-tier edits from Arc 23; the new schema fields + failure modes prose is already canonical).
   - _save_verdict.py
   - _lib/byte_copy.py (or whatever the scope decision in #2 lands on).

4. Add `save-verdict` to `install.sh` `SKILL_NAMES` array (substrate/install.sh line ~140).

5. Exercise the Arc 23 §8.4 substrate-edit smoke-beat discipline against the promotion:
   - `bash substrate/install.sh --dry-run --target project --project-dir <tmp>` lists the save-verdict directory.
   - Same for `--target subproject` and `--target user`.
   - The deployed `~/.claude/skills/save-verdict/_save_verdict.py` is executable and the SKILL.md procedure step 9 actually runs against it.

6. Author probes verifying INCOMPLETE + UNVERIFIABLE verdict bodies that match the SKILL.md prose schema; the Python helper's argument validation rejects malformed inputs at exit 4.

Arc 23 design.md §10.1 + §13.3 + ARGUS round-1 R2 (2026-05-12). The user-tier ls verifying only SKILL.md exists at ~/.claude/skills/save-verdict/ is the load-bearing falsification that drove Option A.

P3. Not blocking. Arc 23 user-tier schema extension is canon-establishing on its own; the Python helper authoring is when caller-side executable enforcement of the new verdict shapes becomes needed. Ride with next substrate skill-related arc.

- Auto-validation of arbitrary verdict bodies against JSONSchema (Arc 23 A6 LOCK: free-form prose validation, caller-side enforcement; not changing here).
- Refactoring the existing PASS / FAIL / NEEDS-REVISIONS path.
